about_the_game:
This free demo of Helmer in the Dragon Tomb lets you experience the opening section of the game. Step into Helmer’s shoes as he defends his father’s farm from the terrifying Nightwalkers and witness the challenges that await deep inside the Dragon Tomb.

The demo showcases the game’s core combat and exploration mechanics and introduces you to the world of the Green Ember. Get a taste of the story and action that await you in the full game.
